messages.author: 0f051a4b7efa96c4
messages.subject: geom_point / scale_x_date problem
parts:
Hi,

I have a dataset for a simple scatter plot with date as x-axis (subset
below)

myo_activity myo_date
54.6 2010-01-05
54.7 2010-01-05
55.6 2010-01-05
56.7 2010-01-05
57.7 2010-01-05
61.9 2010-01-05
46.9 2010-01-06
49.4 2010-01-06
52.2 2010-01-06
53.3 2010-01-06
55 2010-01-06
55.1 2010-01-07
55.8 2010-01-07
56.4 2010-01-07
57.1 2010-01-07

To plot I have done the following, using scale_x_date to trim down and
format the x axis as there are 1000+ data points:
p <- ggplot(data, aes(myo_date, myo_activity))
p + geom_point(aes(colour = myo_type)) + scale_x_date( format="%Y")

or

p + geom_point(aes(colour = myo_type)) + scale_x_date( format="%m/%y")

only problem is the month seems to go from 01 to 09 (rather than to
12) and the year is always 1970?!?!

What am I doing wrong....I have tried formatting the dates to eg
01/01/2010 too but same problem....

Scott
